hooks.name: Infinite continuous-improvement continuation
hooks.description: Resume the next safe, non-trivial improvement wave instead of leaving the project idle.

action.prompt: Resume this project idempotently as the top-level orchestrator. Read the nearest AGENTS.md, current git status/diff, active processes/logs/tests, and .kiro/specs/continuous-improvement/tasks.md when present. Preserve dirty work and never create a second writer. If a writer is active, perform read-only analysis/research/documentation only. Otherwise select the highest-value verifiable improvement, complete diagnosis -> minimal implementation -> targeted tests/runtime or UI proof -> independent verification, record durable evidence, and continue to the next wave. If only trivial work remains, deep-research current official docs, GitHub repos/issues/PRs/discussions, Reddit, forums, papers, security advisories, competitors, and worldwide user complaints; document date, queries, URLs, evidence, applicability, priority, and rejected options in Docs/ or the established docs/ convention, then implement and verify the best validated finding. Never read or expose secrets. Authentication, billing, package installation, destructive data/DB changes, deployment, release/publishing, signing/notarization, commit/push/merge, main/production changes, force-push, and history rewrites require new explicit approval. If execution is unavailable or host load is unsafe, continue with read-only research and durable documentation instead of stopping. Use /kit-doctor, /kit-research, and /kit-upgrade-loop only for kit work.
